title: BANGLASOCIALBENCH: A Benchmark for Evaluating Sociopragmatic and Cultural Alignment of LLMs in Bangladeshi Social Interaction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot accuracy of LLMs on BANGLASOCIALBENCH, a dataset of multiple-choice and pronoun-selection questions testing Bangladeshi social customs, kinship reasoning, and sociopragmatic address terms.
Using discriminative and generative probing with explicit and implicit cues to measure directional asymmetry in the cross-religious substitution of Hindu and Muslim kinship terms.
Analyzing model error rates and patterns of over-politeness across different participant age relations (e.g., Elder to Younger vs. Younger to Elder) using Chi-square tests and standardized residuals.
